headlines.title: Oregon police say four victims dead, including three children, in school shooting
headlines.description: Chief Mike Krantz of the Bend Police Department in Oregon said four victims were killed, including three children and a teacher, in a school shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School. Krantz added that the 16-year-old suspect is also dead.

headlines.title: ‘This is a horrible day’: Oregon Gov. Kotek offers support to Bend community following shooting
headlines.description: Oregon Gov. Tina Kotek said her “heart is broken” after multiple people were killed, including children, at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend. The 16-year-old suspected gunman was killed shortly after police got reports of the incident.

headlines.title: 16-year-old suspect in Bend, Oregon used long gun to shoot at school's locked doors, police say
headlines.description: Authorities said the 16-year-old shooter forced entry into the school by shooting at locked doors using a long gun. NBC News' Tom Winter discusses the damage a long gun is capable of, the heroism of a community member to pursue the suspect and the misinformation that accumulates after a mass shooting.

headlines.title: Aunt of fifth grader at Oregon school shooting says he sounded ‘very scared’ in call to family
headlines.description: Mindy Corely, the aunt of a fifth grader at Silver Rail Elementary said her nephew is still waiting to be reunited with his parents after a shooting at the Oregon school. Corely said her nephew called family with his cellphone and sounded “very, very scared.”

headlines.title: Bend resident recalls hearing gunshots near elementary school shooting
headlines.description: NBC News’ Hallie Jackson spoke with Leah Schwartz, a resident of Bend, who detailed hearing gunshots and sirens while on a walk through the neighborhood where Silver Rail Elementary is located.

headlines.title: Bend mayor says vigil planned for victims of school shooting
headlines.description: The mayor of Bend, Oregon, Melanie Kebler, says that a vigil is planned for the four victims killed in a school shooting. Authorities say a 16-year-old gunman opened fire at Silver Rail Elementary, before being killed by a member of the community.

headlines.title: Superintendent calls Oregon elementary school shooting ’senseless tragedy’
headlines.description: Multiple victims have been reported after a shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon. Bend-La Pine Schools Superintendent Steven Cook said in a statement that the district is "stunned and heartbroken by this senseless tragedy."

headlines.title: Trump looms as tensions flare in final Maine Senate debate
headlines.description: The marathon of debates in the Maine Senate race has ended, but there is still one unanswered question: Just how large will President Donald Trump loom in November?

headlines.title: Trump says Ukraine resuming strikes on Russian oil sites is a ‘disgrace’
headlines.description: President Donald Trump has labeled Ukraine’s resumption of strikes on Russian oil refineries a “disgrace,” the latest salvo in his campaign to pressure the U.S. ally over rising gas prices that could cost Republicans in next month’s Midterm elections.

headlines.title: Brewers sweep Dodgers to reach World Series for first time in 44 years
headlines.description: Milwaukee will face either the Cleveland Guardians or the Tampa Bay Rays in the Fall Classic. The NLCS result ends Los Angeles’ bid to win three straight MLB championships.

headlines.title: Kevin Warsh says Fed is focused on taming rising prices, but gives no hint about next rate hike
headlines.description: Two inflation reports this week set the stage for a rate hike potentially sooner than previously expected.

headlines.title: Mother of 'Breaking Bad' actor RJ Mitte reflects on her son's legacy following his death at 34
headlines.description: The mother of "Breaking Bad" actor RJ Mitte, who died at age 34, speaks to NBC News' Chloe Melas about her son's legacy. Dana Mitte, who found her son's body after his apparent suicide, says she hopes to save others from experiencing the pain of losing a child under such tragic circumstances.
